name: player_ensure_master_type_loop_sfx_handle
description: zUtil_SaveGameState::EnsureMasterTypeLoopSfxHandle starts an indexed master-type loop sample only when no handle is active and the master common data has a sample.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x438630 validate thiscall shape, modeLoopSfxHandle[modeIndex] as the active-handle gate, masterCommonData->sfxWeaponUp[modeIndex] as the configured-sample gate, and StartMasterTypeLoopSfxHandle(saveState, modeIndex, sfxVolume) as the only callee.

Native smoke verifies existing handles suppress playback, missing samples leave the handle null, and configured samples start playback through StartMasterTypeLoopSfxHandle and store the returned play handle.
